decision: Enhance existing renderRuns, composeCells, authorTexture and their existing types; zero new functions, loaders, decoders, resizers, handlers or CLI.

candidates.renderRuns: Owns fitted per-run advances, glyph cursor and final two-stage rounded geometry. Fixed source-sized icons are runs; pass declared icon map explicitly.
candidates.composeCells: Owns base-original identity, preflight whole-cell masks and ordered per-line composition. Source-rectangle and full destination containment, exact copy after each line belong here. Refactor same per-pixel float equations to line-major iteration so each icon copy happens before the next line; no second compositor.
candidates.authorTexture: Owns pinned source decode, immutable base, image/font input and publication. Pass shared BitmapRender.Icons map; no extra asset loader.
candidates.resizeRaster: Intentionally not called for icons: original RGBA copies remain original size. Reconstruction/BICUBIC/donor algorithms held.
candidates.pixelOver: Keep existing word composition; icons use draw.Src to replace even transparent hidden RGB, not alpha blend.

reach: existing native golden and CLI test blocks

data_contract.BitmapRender.Icons: map[string][]int; one shared named same-sheet original source x,y,w,h per recipe. No separate provider or historical handler.
data_contract.BitmapRun.Icon: Alternative to nonempty Text/Fill. Text/Fill omit when empty; old valid text unchanged.
data_contract.BitmapRunLayout.IconGap: optional *float64, nil default2; explicit0 meaningful. Finite0..64.
data_contract.BitmapLayer.Icons: Internal typed source-rectangle + destination-point placement; a new struct groups actual handoff facts, no function.
data_contract.same_sheet: Full source and target rectangles validated, including alpha0 bytes. Keep cell masks disjoint, permit ordered overlap within line/group.
data_contract.tracking_discrepancy: Preserve original measure width (subtract final tracking only if text characters exist) versus text_layer width (always subtract final tracking) for icon-only nonzero tracking. Separate local fitWidth, not an artificial refusal or silent normalization.

precode_proof.native_codec_projection: Expected PNG from frozen original Python first; accepted old Go codec performs unchanged palette projection. No new Go output used.
precode_proof.harness_failures: Before Go implementation: corrected measure arity, removed source palette policy from export-only request, tuple-converted direct source metadata probe. Incomplete precode packs retained; source/algorithms unchanged.

limits: No external donor, dynamic mask, exemplar or BICUBIC implementation.
Reference GameOptical cases do not reproduce existing eight TTF-art operations or claim visual approval.
No family/historical path promotion, savings or completion claim.
implementation_status: WIP saved privately; reviewed source restored while user-requested14-area percentage roadmap is prepared. No icon capability accepted.
